en: Black-and-white postcard view of a cobblestoned square with a historic gabled building labeled "Ratskeller" (a town hall cellar restaurant). A statue of a man in a long coat stands on a pedestal in the foreground. Surrounding are multi-story town buildings with traditional German architectural elements. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as the Ratskeller in Pulsnitz with the Rietschel monument.
